rationale: The assistant correctly identified normal cooling-fan run-on from the first message ('Most microwaves have a cooling fan that runs for several minutes after cooking'), hedged appropriately, and confirmed the benign diagnosis once the customer said it 'stops on its own after a few minutes' with only a steady whirr. It used only what the customer said and recommended no parts or repair. Minor gaps: it asked about noise quality rather than the more diagnostic questions (does it stop by itself, longer after grill/convection, runs when cold) and did not mention the one caveat that constant running when cold would warrant a Samsung warranty call, but the customer was well served.
